_comment: SYNC-THINK shell design tokens — SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the desktop shell palette. Regenerate CSS with `pnpm tokens:css` (scripts/generate-shell-tokens.mjs → apps/desktop/src/renderer/shell/tokens.css). Never hand-edit tokens.css. Color values are written as [light, dark] tuples so every token is forced to declare both themes; a bare string means the token is theme-agnostic. Supersedes 15-frontend-design-tokens.json (the deleted legacy --st-* system, which carried a second, blue accent).

groups._note: One sans stack for the whole shell, CJK fallbacks included. Components must consume the token rather than re-declaring a family: a local stack that omitted PingFang/YaHei is what made Chinese text in the reasoning block render in a different face from everything around it.

tokens.sans: 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei UI', system-ui, sans-serif
tokens.mono: 'Cascadia Code', 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups._note:
Surface stack, sampled pixel-for-pixel from NewMax light mode.
The window background (--color-page) is the *darkest* layer: both the
sidebar and the stage float on top of it as inset boards, so the visible
gutter between them is the page showing through.
  page (#f2eee6) < sidebar (#f6f4ef) < stage (#faf9f5) < overlay (#ffffff)
The ramp is warm beige, not neutral gray — dropping the warmth is what
made our shell read as "cold" next to the reference. Dark mirrors the
same ordering, with hues carrying a trace of warmth (green/red slightly
above blue) so it reads as the same product rather than a cold blue-gray.

Stage sub-surfaces. Light keeps the historical flat values so the beige
ramp is unchanged; dark follows the product spec: stage panel + tab strip
#343736, chat canvas #1e1f1f (selected tabs share it), inner boxes
#2a2d2b.

_notes.accent-fg: Foreground for text/icons sitting on --color-accent. Dark flips this to a near-black because the dark accent is a bright mint and white text on it fails contrast.

groups._note:
Sidebar selection in NewMax is *recessed*, not raised: the pill is filled
with the page color so it reads as a hole punched through the sidebar
board. Hence --color-active === --color-page by design, in both themes.

Status colors follow the theme: dark uses higher-luminance variants to
hold contrast on the dark surfaces. `success` references accent directly
so the two greens cannot drift apart across a theme switch.

Modal shadow is pinned to near-black in BOTH themes: light text tokens
(e.g. dark-mode --color-text) would otherwise glow around the card. Dark
uses a heavier drop so the card sits on, not above, the scrim.

Capability center: a light, neutral governance workbench by default.
TODO(batch-c): collapse this 50-token sub-palette into var(--color-*)
aliases, keeping only the handful of genuinely distinct values.

Provider brand accents are tokens so model settings can be re-themed.
Theme-agnostic on purpose: these are real vendor brand colors, not part
of the skinnable palette.
